leads.why_now: MyFreightWorld is expanding in West Palm Beach in late August 2026, moving to a larger office and adding 41 jobs.

evidence.signal_title: MyFreightWorld Expands in West Palm Beach, Adding 41 Jobs
evidence.signal_excerpt: MyFreightWorld Expands in West Palm Beach, Adding 41 Jobs # National Logistics Company to Expand West Palm Beach Operations August 26, 2026 – West Palm Beach, FL – The Business Development Board of the Palm Beaches today announced the expansion of MyFreightWorld, a national third-party logistics company in West Palm Beach. The company will add 41 new team members over the next few years at an average income of $94,000. MyFreightWorld will move from its current location at 400 Clematis Street, Suite 203, into a 7,296-square-foot suite at 2090 Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard in West Palm Beach. The larger space is designed to support the company’s rapid growth and increased shipment activity across Palm Beach County and the country where it currently manages 25,000 shipments annually. As it grows its current workforce from 20 to a total of 61 employees, the new positions are primarily for Account Executives and Account Management. Palm Beach County residents can apply online. About the Expansion: - Jobs: 41 new jobs in West Palm Beach; 20 current employees - Pay: $94,000 average income - Types of new roles: Account Executives, Account Management - Link to apply: https://www.myfreight

company_lookup.source_excerpt: # MyFreightWorld Inc. MyFreightWorld Inc. (MYFT) is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. MyFreightWorld is a third-party logistics company that delivers seamless freight management and transportation solutions. MyFreightWorld Inc. employs 151 people (+15.3% YoY, +20 people) and has an annual revenue of $23.5M, founded in 1999. Headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, United States, with an office in Overland. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, Colombia, and Armenia. ## About MyFreightWorld (MFW) makes the wheels of transportation less squeaky, and has been doing so for over 20 years! MFW helps source transportation solutions and technology for Manufacturers, Distributors, and Retailers. We specialize in Managed Services and Freight Brokerage, managing and arranging the movement of LTL, FTL (Dry Van, Flatbed, Reefer, Drayage, Tanker, Hopper, Oversized), Intermodal, Ocean, and Air. Additionally, we perform small package consulting services. MFW is proud of the technology we bring to our customers, resulting in a more efficient shipping process - integrating into several different ERP systems. Mostly, we're proud of the team we have assembled. Full of individuals that have an extremely high level of care when it comes to executing for our customers. suggestions.why: About 10 of the logistics firms opening new sites had 50-99 staff, just under the minimum.
Only about 1 in 15 candidates fit, so reaching 10 leads needs more searches and checks than $1 pays for.

notes.text: For 3PL facility news, most hits are too small (under 100 staff) or global giants; cold-storage providers and regional US 3PLs with press releases (e.g. FreezPak, RGL Logistics) fit the 100-1000 range best. UK lease news mostly misses.
